title: One person can fill a gym's daily friend-enquiry allowance with fake leads
what: Each member's invite link takes 5 friend forms a day, and the whole gym takes 30 a day. Anyone can join a gym's member app with the code printed on its poster, so one person with six app sign-ups has six invite links and can send 30 made-up names and numbers in a day. The desk gets 30 fake enquiries to chase, and every real friend who fills the form that day is told it did not go through.
expected: Fake forms from one person stay a handful, and real friends of other members still get through on a busy day.
how_often: only when someone does it on purpose
fix_line: Count the daily friend limit per app sign-up age or per phone, and do not let one gym-wide ceiling be used up by new sign-ups

title: Once the Pro lock is on, a Starter gym can keep rewriting the diet plans it made in its trial
what: The server's Pro lock only refuses NEW diet plans. Changing an existing plan is not checked, and a change can replace its title, meals and who gets it. A gym that made a few diet plans during its free trial can keep turning them into new plans for new members for ever on Starter. The lock is not switched on yet.
expected: After the trial a Starter gym can still read or withdraw its old diet plans, but not rewrite them into new ones.
how_often: only when a gym does it on purpose
fix_line: Also check the plan when an existing diet plan is changed

title: Any desk can skip the 'more than this member owes' check by marking a receipt as taken offline
what: The server lets a receipt be more than the plan still owes when the receipt says it was taken with no internet and its number is in a desk's offline series. The server cannot tell whether the desk really was offline: it only reads a yes/no the desk itself sends. So a desk that is online can save any amount on any plan the same way, and the owner only sees an 'overpaid' note later.
expected: Only receipts really printed while offline skip the check, and the owner is told each time one does.
how_often: only when a desk person does it on purpose
fix_line: Accept the offline skip only for receipts dated before the desk last came online, and list each one for the owner
